source.title: חוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, התשנ"ד-1994, ss.4, 9, 13, 25(א), 129ג (Wikisource mirror); חוק ניירות ערך, התשכ"ח-1968, s.2 (Wikisource mirror)

regulator.notes: The Israel Securities Authority (רשות ניירות ערך) approves fund managers (s.13) and trustees (s.9), permits every prospectus (s.25(א)) and may set rules for money-market funds (s.129ג, added by Amendment 31 in force 3.10.2024). Fund law read on a mirror; re-read on the official text before relying on wording (coverage §0).

source.title: חוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, ss.5(א)(12), 80(א)(1) (Wikisource mirror); ISA investor guide (2017) pp. 7, 22-24

balance.notes: No regulated cap on the management fee (שכר מנהל הקרן) or the trustee fee (שכר נאמן): both are set in the fund agreement and prospectus, computed daily as an annual % of assets and deducted inside the unit price (MF-16, MF-20). The ISA's end-2025 average for money-market funds is in MF-18. Increases only on 1 January (MF-17). The distribution fee the manager pays the bank is capped at 0.1% a year for money-market funds and comes out of the manager's fee (MF-24).

source.title: ISA, מדריך למשקיע: קרנות נאמנות (January 2017), p. 24

trustee.notes: No cap found. The 2017 guide gives 0% to 0.25% a year, average about 0.05% (dated; MF open question 6). The rate is in each fund's prospectus.

load.notes: No regulated cap: the maximum load (הוספה) must be stated in the fund agreement, and its rate in the prospectus; the 2017 ISA guide says the vast majority of funds charge none (current share is MF open question 7).

redemption_deduction.notes: No regulated cap: a deduction from the redemption price is allowed only if the fund agreement provides for it, with its maximum stated there (current share of funds charging one is MF open question 7).

source.title: Distribution fee regulations 2006, reg. 2(ב)-(ד) (Wikisource mirror); BoI fees rules 2008, First Schedule part 4(א)(1)

trade.notes: Under a distribution agreement a distributor may not charge the holder of money-market (type 4) units any fee for buying, holding or redeeming (reg. 2(ד)); without an agreement it may charge up to the distribution fee it could have charged the manager (reg. 2(ב)). A bank's part-4 buy/sell commission excludes mutual funds other than tracking and listed funds (BRK-16, MF-27 Leumi). A non-bank member's commission is per its tariff (MF-27: IBI up to 0.08%, minimum NIS 5, 1.7.2026).

source.title: כללי הבנקאות (שירות ללקוח) (עמלות), התשס"ח-2008, consolidated to 5.11.2024, First Schedule part 4(א)(5) note (2)

custody.notes: At a bank: no securities custody fee (דמי ניהול פיקדון ניירות ערך) may be charged on a money-market fund as defined in the Joint Investment Trust regulations. Under a distribution agreement, a distributor that is not an investment marketer may charge the holder nothing for buying, holding or redeeming money-market units (MF-26, reg. 2(ד)). Most non-bank TASE members are investment marketers, outside those regulations, and no rule limits their custody fee on money-market units (BRK-17, BRK-52; BRK open question 11 closed 2026-10-26): there the tariff applies as published (MF-27 examples).

labels: per-fund tax track: 2 of 73 money-market funds are taxable (TXS-24); taxable fund computed as 15% of nominal interest at fund level, the individual's rate as circular 7/2003 s.2.1.1 says (TXS-11)

lawful_exit.text: only on the fund's fixed dates, set in the fund agreement and chosen when buying (the ISA's examples: a week, a month, a quarter); the interval between fixed dates is at most 12 months (36 with ISA leave); money cannot be withdrawn before the next fixed date; a holding that is not redeemed at a fixed date renews automatically for the next period; advance notice may be required only when the interval exceeds one year (MF-38); on a fixed date the redemption money reaches the holder's account on the day the distributor must pass the order to the clearing house in a fund whose investment policy keeps foreign securities at no more than 10% of net assets, and on the next trading day in any other fund (MF-11, prices regulations reg. 15; MF open question 4 closed 2026-10-26)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.88 definition "מכירה" (includes פדיון and חליפין) (Wikisource mirror)

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Redeeming one fund to buy another, or selling units to move money, is a sale: the real gain is taxed (withheld) even if the money never leaves the account. No order under s.101A(a)(12) deeming exempt-fund units sold and repurchased was found (TXS open question 9).

eligibility.text: anyone with a securities account at a bank or at a TASE member (the distributor); most funds have no minimum investment, though a distributor may set its own account minimum or minimum commission; units of a new series are offered from seven days after the series date (MF-35)

protection.text: as for every money-market fund: assets held by the trustee for the unit holders, separate and not attachable; if the manager or trustee fails the fund moves to another manager; the expected yield is the manager's estimate, net of fund fees and before tax, and is not guaranteed; market losses are not protected and there is no state guarantee
